free_tier.stated: Personal edition, CNY 8.88 one-time: 2 tunnels, free traffic from a daily check-in that does not reset, supports TCP/UDP/HTTP/HTTPS tunnels; this edition is available on registration. [translated]

egress.terms: No monthly byte figure is published for the personal edition; traffic comes from a daily check-in that the vendor says does not reset at month end. The advanced edition states 500 GB of permanent traffic as a one-off.; ingress: udp

interface_detail: A web console for tunnel creation and a frp-based client.
tooling: frp-based client plus wg-quick on the local box
chaining: If the check-in traffic is large, a one-off CNY 8.88 is the cheapest UDP ingress; it still cannot be reached for free.

limits.value: daily check-in traffic, not reset at month end; amount not published

binding_note: The entry price is CNY 8.88 rather than zero, and the traffic figure is not published, so no constraint can be named from the page read.

identity_cost.detail: Registration asks for an account name, an email address, an emailed verification code, an invite code and a password. The invite code link points to a storefront at afdian.com, so the account cannot be created without buying one; the entry price on the price table is CNY 8.88 one-time.

reliability_note: None established; the vendor advertises nodes from various upstream providers rather than owning them.
confidence_note: The price table is on the vendor page read. What would raise the rung is the check-in amount and whether a free account exists at all, which needs a console login.

evidence.proved: personal edition CNY 8.88 one-time with 2 tunnels and check-in traffic; advanced edition CNY 199 with 500 GB; enterprise CNY 499/year with 1 TB monthly
registration fields are account, email, emailed code, invite code obtained from afdian.com, password

notes: A community FRP service, not a company. Nearly free rather than free: one payment of CNY 8.88 buys the account and the traffic is earned by check-in. Worth recording because 500 GB for CNY 199 one-off is the cheapest large block seen, but neither is a free tier.

extras.wg_detail: TCP/UDP/HTTP/HTTPS tunnels are sold on every tier, so a WG datagram can ride a UDP tunnel. No WG config is issued.
extras.volume_stated: No monthly byte figure is published for the personal edition; traffic comes from a daily check-in that the vendor says does not reset at month end. The advanced edition states 500 GB of permanent traffic as a one-off.
